# Submission package (generated by paper/v3/build.py; do not edit by hand)

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `manuscript.tex` / `manuscript.pdf` | Anonymised manuscript (no author names, affiliations or acknowledgements); APA 7 references inline; compiles on its own with the figure files below |
| `title_page.tex` / `title_page.pdf` | Separate title page: authors, affiliations, corresponding author, acknowledgements, competing interests, funding, CRediT — **to be completed by the authors** |
| `highlights.txt` | 3–5 highlights, each ≤ 85 characters (checked by the build) |
| `Figure_1.pdf` | Vector figure 1 (`figures/fig_forecast.pdf`); caption in the manuscript |
| `Figure_2.pdf` | Vector figure 2 (`figures/fig_evaluation_matrix.pdf`); caption in the manuscript |
| `Figure_3.pdf` | Vector figure 3 (`figures/fig_phantom_gain.pdf`); caption in the manuscript |
| `Figure_4.pdf` | Vector figure 4 (`figures/fig_in_sim_vs_phantom.pdf`); caption in the manuscript |
| `Figure_5.pdf` | Vector figure 5 (`figures/fig_implied_learning.pdf`); caption in the manuscript |
| `Figure_6.pdf` | Vector figure 6 (`figures/fig_gain_effort.pdf`); caption in the manuscript |
| `supplementary/*.csv` | Values and intervals behind the figures and tables (cited as supplementary files) |
| `cover_letter_draft.md` | Draft cover letter — to be completed and signed by the authors |

Not included on purpose: a graphical abstract (optional for this journal; generative-AI or AI-assisted production of graphical abstracts is not permitted, so the authors should draw it themselves if wanted).
